strings: r_c0 notices that m_c struggles to see in the dark, more so than the other kits. {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/speak/speaks} to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} and {VERB/r_c0/discover/discovers} that m_c has snow vision.

m_c is permanently seeing a snowy effect in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision, and when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/speaks/speak} to a medicine cat about it, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/discover/discovers} that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} snow vision.
m_c casually jokes about the static in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision, only to find out that it is not a universal experience. It turns out m_c has snow vision.
